source_text: Finally, the carbamate bendiocarb has recently replaced lambda-cyhalothrin in IRS on Zanzibar [17] and our bioassay data show that all mosquitoes tested to date are completely susceptible to this insecticide (100% mortality, Unguja N = 57; Pemba N = 192; Additional file 2).
